items.example: The secretary called the proceedings a farce.
items.cloze: The secretary called the proceedings a ______.
items.analysis_zh: call something a farce 表示公开斥责某项程序荒唐、缺乏公信力；a farce 是单数可数名词，前面需要不定冠词。与 mistake（错误）相比，farce 带有更强烈的价值判断，甚至暗示程序流于形式，但这是发言者的评价。例句中 called 引出其定性，不应写成客观结论。可迁移说 The hearing was dismissed as a farce。

items.example: The accusations concerned military decisions, among other things.
items.analysis_zh: among other things 是插入性固定短语，表示所列内容只是多个事项中的一部分，通常用逗号与主体分开，放句中或句末均可。与 and so on 相比，它更适合在正式叙述中提示清单未列尽。此处只说指控涉及军事决定等事项，没有暗示其他事项已被逐项证实。会议纪要可写 We discussed delivery risks, among other things。
items.cloze: The accusations concerned military decisions, ______.
items.hint_zh: 用于概括列举但未穷尽的事项。

items.example: The firm hopes to raise as much as $64bn through its listing.
items.analysis_zh: as much as + 金额表示最高可达某一金额，强调上限或潜在规模；用于可计量的金额，as many as 则用于可数数量。The firm hopes to raise 表示计划和希望，不能将 $64bn 视为已到账资金。与 at least（至少）方向相反。商业预测可写 The project could require as much as $2m in investment。
items.cloze: The firm hopes to raise ______ $64bn through its listing.
items.hint_zh: 常用于强调大额上限，注意与 as many as 的可数差别。

items.example: House Republicans blocked an impeachment attempt.
items.analysis_zh: block an attempt to do something 表示阻止某项尝试进入下一步或取得成功，block 为及物动词，直接接 attempt；attempt 后常以 to do 引出目标。与 reject a proposal 相比，block 更强调程序受阻，不能推出所有类似动议永久失去可能。可迁移说 A procedural objection blocked an attempt to amend the agreement。
items.cloze: House Republicans ______ an impeachment attempt.
items.hint_zh: 结构：block an attempt to do something。
items.why_zh: block an attempt to do something 表示阻止某项尝试进入下一步或取得成功，block 为及物动词，直接接 attempt；attempt 后常以 to do 引出目标。与 reject a proposal 相比，block 更强调程序受阻，不能推出所有类似动议永久失去可能。可迁移说 A procedural objection blocked an attempt to amend the agreement。

items.meaning_zh: 关键爆发点（came to a head）
items.example: The dispute came to a head after the suspension.
items.analysis_zh: come to a head 表示积累已久的矛盾发展到关键爆发点，常与 dispute、crisis、tension 连用。这里 came 是 come 的过去式，after the suspension 给出触发节点；与 begin 不同，该短语暗示之前已有发展过程。项目管理可说 The disagreement over responsibilities came to a head during the review meeting。
items.cloze: The dispute came to a ______ after the suspension.
items.hint_zh: 使用过去式 came；突出长期累积的矛盾到了临界点。

items.example: Authorities said they would carry out the sentence.
items.cloze: Authorities said they would ______ out the sentence.
items.analysis_zh: carry out a sentence 表示执行判决，carry out 为及物短语动词，其宾语是 sentence；carry out an investigation 则是开展调查。said they would carry out 属于转述当局计划，would 为情态动词后接原形 carry，不能据此断言判决已经执行。与 hand down a sentence（宣判）区分。可迁移 carry out a court order。

items.example: Police clashed with protesters at the rallies.
items.analysis_zh: clash with somebody 表示与某方发生冲突，with 标记冲突另一方；clash over something 则引出争议事项。clashed 是过去式，at the rallies 标明场景。与 protested against 相比，clash 更突出实际对抗，具体是否暴力仍须看报道证据。还可说 The two departments clashed over the implementation schedule。

items.example: The ruling concerned consensual relations between adults.
items.analysis_zh: consensual 是形容词，修饰 relations，表示有关各方自愿同意；consent 是名词或动词，不能在此直接替换形容词。between adults 限定主体范围，在法律语境中同意与合法性是不同层面，须留意当地法律规定。常见搭配 consensual relationship、mutual consent；正式文本中可说 The arrangement was consensual。

items.example: The court overturned laws criminalising consensual acts.
items.analysis_zh: criminalise an act 表示在法律上把某行为规定为犯罪，英国英语写 criminalise，美国英语常写 criminalize。这里 criminalising 是现在分词作后置定语，修饰 laws，相当于 laws that criminalised ...；overturned 才是主句谓语。与 prosecute（起诉具体人员）区分。可迁移 legislation criminalising certain conduct。
items.cloze: The court overturned laws ______ consensual acts.
items.why_zh: criminalise an act 表示在法律上把某行为规定为犯罪，英国英语写 criminalise，美国英语常写 criminalize。这里 criminalising 是现在分词作后置定语，修饰 laws，相当于 laws that criminalised ...；overturned 才是主句谓语。与 prosecute（起诉具体人员）区分。可迁移 legislation criminalising certain conduct。

items.example: Opposition parties denounced the suspension.
items.cloze: Opposition parties ______ the suspension.
items.analysis_zh: denounce a decision / denounce the suspension 表示公开强烈谴责某决定，denounce 为及物动词，直接接宾语，无需介词。与 criticise 相比强度更高，但表示反对者的态度，不能独立证明该决定违法。过去式 denounced 对应报道事件时间。可迁移 The opposition denounced the emergency measures。

items.example: The talks did little to halt the fighting.
items.analysis_zh: do little to + 动词原形表示对实现某结果几乎没有帮助；did little to halt 中 halt 是原形，不能写成 halting。与 fail to 完全未实现相比，did little to 强调效果甚微，未必绝对为零。句子评价谈判遏制冲突的实际效果。项目复盘可说 The corrective action did little to reduce the backlog。

items.example: The rules violated fundamental rights.
items.cloze: The rules violated ______ rights.
items.analysis_zh: fundamental rights 指具有基础性地位的权利，rights 为复数，fundamental 为前置形容词；与 ordinary contractual rights 相比更强调宪法或人权框架中的核心保护。violate rights 是固定动宾搭配，不能从法院认定直接推断其适用于所有法域。写法律分析可用 protect fundamental rights 或 infringe fundamental rights。

items.meaning_zh: 缺席（法律拉丁语表达中）

items.example: Such third-party bots would therefore be unable to transact on travellers' behalf through the airline's systems.

items.example: The company reported a substantial increase in net profit.
items.analysis_zh: net profit 是扣除相关成本与费用后的净利润，区别于 gross profit 毛利润和 revenue 营收。increase in net profit 中 in 表示某项指标的增长，不能把 increase of 和 increase in 在所有语境下随意替换：前者常引出增量数额，后者引出发生增长的指标。财报解读应核对利润增长的基期与金额。

items.example: Vladimir Putin said Russia would not compromise on its conditions for ending the war in Ukraine.
items.analysis_zh: compromise on conditions 表示在条件或立场上妥协，compromise with somebody 强调与某一方达成折中，reach a compromise 则用名词。would not compromise 中 would 后接原形；在过去叙述中可能表示当时的立场或预测，不能机械理解成已经发生的让步。商务谈判可说 We cannot compromise on product safety requirements。

items.example: He insisted that Russia would control territories it claims to have annexed.
